name: Staked USD Coin
oneLiner: HedgeCore sUSD is a soul-bound BSC yield wrapper minted from USDC and routed through Venus lending; early redemption is operator-controlled, not a backstop.
collateral: USDC supplied to the Venus Protocol USDC lending market on BNB Chain via HedgeCore's StrategyRouter and Venus USD vault; the on-chain vUSDC lending position is the only backing (no fiat reserve or attestation)
pegMechanism: Users deposit USDC to mint soul-bound sUSD 1:1; Venus lending interest accrues in vUSDC and is distributed to holders by operator-triggered rewardMint() calls (93% to sUSD holders, 7% protocol fee); liquidity is provided only through a one-way hUSDC->sUSD ERC-20 wrapper (no reverse conversion), and redemption is operator-controlled rather than a free liquid backstop

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At BSC block 110064032, replayed through BSC Blast API, the sole tracked sUSD deployment 0xbe1922750760c4cae69edb6fe79a22ae9b62a23d was a direct 3,757-byte contract whose wrapper() resolved to 0x34eea40fb819bfc762b836dd6269f975227794d3; both token and wrapper EIP-1967 implementation slots were zero. The token DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and wrapper owner() were EOA 0x30829883394adfc36f95a84881be1254f60bdd35, and the wrapper held the token BURNER_ROLE. Verified wrapper source exposes hedgeBurnLocked(from, amount) to that owner or an OPERATOR_ROLE account; it calls the BURNER_ROLE-gated reclaimFromWrapper(from, amount), which burns the specified holder without an allowance. An eth_call from the owner successfully simulated a one-wei hedgeBurnLocked against address 0x67a2d21c408efbba83de8fe081ca31e38e15e745, which then held 3,229.290083316479002966 sUSD and had no active wrapper lock. Separately, SUDC _update only blocks a transfer that would consume an active per-address wrapper lock; otherwise it executes the standard ERC-20 update, and a zero-value transfer simulation returned true. This is a direct holder-burn and lock-aware transfer-control path. Issuer documentation conflicts between a soul-bound/non-transferable claim and the live transferable-sUSD page; it is context only, not evidence of authority. This access review makes no finding about legal terms, proof of reserves, or transparency because no corresponding official artifact is cited or relied upon for this classification.

notices.title: Restricted transfer and redemption path
notices.message: HedgeCore docs describe sUSD as soul-bound, and early redemption is operator-controlled rather than a general liquid backstop.

mintAuthority.summary: HedgeCore sUSD uses OZ AccessControl. The hUSDC wrapper contract (0x34EEa40FB…) holds MINTER_ROLE; DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by EOA 0x30829883…. MAX_SUPPLY is a Solidity constant at 1B tokens.

controls.label: HedgeCore hUSDC wrapper contract (MINTER_ROLE holder)
controls.capDescription: MAX_SUPPLY is a Solidity constant (≈1B tokens); issueFromWrapper() requires MINTER_ROLE and checks MAX_SUPPLY.
controls.evidence: At BSC block 103632643, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x34eea40fb819bfc762b836dd6269f975227794d3) returned true. wrapper() on sUSD returns the same address, cross-confirming the on-chain wrapper. eth_getCode on 0x34eea… returned 5674-byte contract. MAX_SUPPLY() = 1B tokens (immutable Solidity constant, no setter).

controls.label: HedgeCore DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (EOA)
controls.evidence: At BSC block 103632643, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x30829883394adfc36f95a84881be1254f60bdd35) returned true. Also confirmed as wrapper() owner(). eth_getCode on 0x30829… returned empty bytecode (EOA). This EOA can grantRole/revokeRole to change the wrapper minter.

controls.label: HedgeCore operator (USDC deposit / Venus strategy / redemption)
controls.evidence: HedgeCore docs describe an operator running USDC deposit, Venus lending strategy, and operator-controlled early redemption; wrapper mint is gated behind this operator-controlled flow.

review.evidence: At BSC block 103632643: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, wrapper 0x34eea40fb…) = true; hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, EOA 0x30829883…) = true; wrapper() = 0x34eea40fb… (confirmed cross-match). 0x30829883… is EOA (empty bytecode). MAX_SUPPLY() = 1B (immutable constant, no setter function). HedgeCore docs confirm soul-bound soul mechanism and operator redemption flow.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: HedgeCore sUSD is a USDC-funded lending receipt over a Venus position, with operator-controlled redemption rather than borrower debt.
